about: Every problem code the GRIND API can return (urn:grind:problem:<code>), with what the app does and says. The app maps codes to messages from this file, never from the problem's title. Tests in grind-api and grind-partner fail the build if a code is missing here, listed here but not in the code, or given a different status.

retry.never: Retrying the same request fails again.
retry.later: Retry with exponential backoff and jitter, honouring Retry-After.
retry.after_refetch: Fetch the latest data, then retry the change on top of it.
retry.after_sign_in: Refresh or renew the session, then retry once.
retry.after_update: Only after the app is updated.

action.report: A bug in the app or server: show the message with the support code, record it in diagnostics.
action.fix: The user can fix it (shorter text, smaller file, other input).
action.sign_in: Take the user to sign in again.
action.update: Show the update screen with a link to the store.
action.wait: Keep the change queued; sync retries in the background.
action.refetch: Sync down first, then retry automatically.
action.reconnect: Ask the user to connect the partner again.
action.stop: Stop syncing for this account and explain.
